clips.title: The story
paras: At the Tower of Althalaxx in northern Darkshore, Worn Parchment scraps offer clues to the cultists gathered there.

North along Darkshore’s mist-shrouded coast, dark spellcasters and their followers have seized the ruined Tower of Althalaxx. Dark Strand Fanatics patrol the grounds outside and carry scraps of worn parchment among their belongings. One scrap holds only scattered writing and strange symbols. Gathered together, the fragments reveal a previously unknown organization called the Cult of the Dark Strand.
